title: More ways to use and configure agents
summary:
Agents gained a CLI integration, configurable metadata, and Pollen Quests, while media playback and community listings got more useful.

A new provider brings Pollinations chat models to Simon Willison’s `llm` CLI and Python library, discovering eligible models and their capabilities from the catalog. Endpoint agents now receive request metadata across Chat Completions, Responses, and POST /text; Polli uses `metadata.model` to select its inner model.

Two one-time Quests reward a successful agent request with 0.25 Pollen and an agent that receives a successful request with 2 Pollen. A creator’s own test request counts.

Dashboard Markdown now plays supported audio and video inline, keeps images in place, and adds Copy buttons to fenced code blocks. Approved community publishers can add icons to their profiles for use in model listings; 14 existing app entries also gained missing screenshots.

highlights.title: Pollinations meets `llm`
highlights.text: Use Pollinations chat models through Simon Willison’s `llm` CLI or Python library. The provider discovers supported models and their vision, tool, and reasoning capabilities from the catalog.

highlights.title: Configure agents with metadata
highlights.text: Pass agent-specific settings in request metadata across Chat Completions, Responses, and POST /text. For Polli, use `metadata.model` to choose its inner model. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Two agent Quests
highlights.text: Earn 0.25 Pollen for a successful request to an eligible agent, or 2 Pollen when an agent you create receives a successful request. Your own test request counts toward the creator Quest.

highlights.title: Play media inline
highlights.text: Dashboard Markdown now plays supported audio and video links inline and keeps images where they appear. Fenced code blocks also have a Copy button.

highlights.title: Publisher icons for models
highlights.text: Approved community publishers can add a profile icon that appears beside their models in Enter’s desktop and mobile listings. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
